ShortDescription.Value: Tune whitecaps, ocean swell and native water materials from the Cities: Skylines II options menu.

Publish.LongDescription:
Water Features Plus gives you control over the native water surface. Start with scattered whitecaps, then tune the long swell and its secondary wave band independently. Other groups let you adjust water clarity and color, surface smoothness, fine ripples and underwater caustics.
Open Options → Water Features Plus after loading a city. The default profile adjusts foam only. To try longer waves, open Waves → Ocean swell and select the long swell preset. Switch off Apply adjustments in General to compare the same view with the game's water.
Includes English and Brazilian Portuguese. Settings apply across cities. Ocean swell requires a surface classified as ocean, sea or lake by the game. Pool surfaces are excluded.

ChangeLog.Value: First public release. Includes surface foam, two swell bands, material controls, caustics and English and Brazilian Portuguese options.
